title: SM-09.12 - Who receives inactive survey deletion notifications
intent: This article answers: SM-09.12 - Who receives inactive survey deletion notifications
short_answer: Inactivity notifications are sent to the survey owner and to privileged users who have management rights for the survey, such as Form Manager users.
important_conditions: Users with management privileges should review the survey and coordinate with the owner if action is required.
